## otakumode.com (Information)

- https://otakumode.com/otapedia/games/final_fantasy/last_order -- story, dates, credits -- accessed 2026-10-17 (fetched by me, text pasted by user; Tokyo Otaku Mode's Otapedia, sections Plot, Cast and Characters, Reception)
  - Story: a 25-minute OVA based on two flashbacks from Final Fantasy VII: Sephiroth learns of Jenova and burns Nibelheim, and the second flashback gives backstory to Zack and Cloud's escape from Shinra, ending with the Turks capturing them; agrees with the entry's description (a re-imagining of two flashbacks from VII, one with Sephiroth and another for Zack and Cloud); the details are spoilers and not copied
  - Release and credits: released in 2005 in Japan and in 2007 in North America, made by Madhouse for Square Enix, directed by Morio Asaka, written by Kazuhiko Inukai, produced by Masao Maruyama, Jungo Murata and Akio Ofuji, with Tetsuya Nomura as supervising director and Yoshinori Kitase as executive producer; the score by Takeharu Ishimoto, with the ending theme "Last Order", was released with the Before Crisis score on one soundtrack in Japan on December 19, 2007; consistent with the entry's length (25 minutes), its 2005 date and its note that the OVA was included in Advent Pieces: Ultimate Edition (2005, Japan) and the Advent Children Limited Edition Collector's Set (2007, North America)
  - Reception was mixed, with some praising how it filled in the game's plot and others criticizing the changes to the events in Nibelheim (a reception note outside our scope); it mentions a remake "soon to be re-released in 2020", stale; its Links section names only https://www.square-enix.com/
